snippet.title: optimal conditions for a trailer
snippet.description:
hello!
announcement! 

steam release of 'optimal conditions for a sacrifice' is scheduled on the next st valentine's day, 14.02.2025! (no guarantees though, i don't know how long and successful the approval would be...)

for now it's unfortunately windows only, i'm still figuring out and testing macOS build... but if you're a mac user and owner you can purchase the game via itch OR contact me to help me in the playtest via steam! 

https://mossinasi.itch.io/sacrifice

please contact me if you'd like to receive a game for free in exchange for your review on steam (doesn't have to be a positive review! i know my game's weird and tiny and def not for everyone's tastes haha) OR if you have purchased the game before via itch.io! (i'll look up your e-mail and provide you a steam copy) 

Thank you!
